faucets.name: Fantom Faucet
faucets.notes: Fantom's testnet is deprecated — the network rebranded to Sonic, and faucet.fantom.network no longer dispenses. There is no working public Fantom testnet faucet right now (thirdweb's requires real mainnet funds). If you need tokens for the successor network, look for a Sonic Labs testnet faucet.
